title: Clearing account items open more than 30 days
prompt: Show all clearing account items older than 30 days and explain what each appears to relate to.

setup.q: Which accounts are clearing or suspense accounts?
How many days should an item normally take to clear?

inputs.name: Bank statements or processor settlement reports

steps: pull the single-account ledger for each clearing account from the start of the year
run open_item_age to pair debits with credits and age what is left open
for each open item older than the threshold, say what it appears to relate to and what would clear it
tie the open items to the account balance

done.text: Every exception row cites the transaction id and the account
The open items listed sum to each clearing account's balance at the cutoff
clearing-items.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Items are aged individually, not as the net account balance
